PROPOSALDESK CHECKLISTMethod guide · 3 min read

The last review before submission.

A structured final pass helps a proposal team focus on preventable errors while there is still time to act.

Method guide
Syful Hoque
01

Reconcile the requirements

Check eligibility, instructions, formats, signatures, annexes and the deadline against the actual tender documents.

02

Follow the logic across sections

Make sure the methodology, workplan, team responsibilities, outputs and budget describe the same engagement.

03

Check every material claim

Confirm that project experience, qualifications, roles and dates are accurate and supported.

04

Review the submission package

Check file names, versions, page limits, required attachments and the prescribed submission method.

05

Leave time for the final handover

Assign one person to confirm the complete package and submission receipt. Do not assume that a finished draft is a submitted proposal.
